windsurf-dev-containers.contributes.comm: Show Devin Desktop Dev Containers Log
windsurf-dev-containers.contributes.conf: Docker Compose executable name or path. It is used only when the Docker executable has no `compose` subcommand. Default: `docker-compose`.
Docker executable name or path that Dev Containers uses. This is one value for all windows and all hosts: in a Remote-SSH or WSL window, the same name or path is used on that host.

Command to run after the dotfiles repository is cloned. When empty, the first of `install.sh`, `install`, `bootstrap.sh`, `bootstrap`, `script/bootstrap`, `setup.sh`, `setup` and `script/setup` found in the repository runs; when none exists, the dotfiles in the repository root are symlinked into the home directory.
URL of a dotfiles Git repository (for example `https://github.com/owner/repository.git`) to clone into each Dev Container and install after it is created.
Path in the container to clone the dotfiles repository to.
Enable SSH agent forwarding when connecting to devcontainers.
Disable the server checksum verification. This is only recommended for development and testing.

Run the lifecycle commands from `devcontainer.json` (`onCreateCommand`, `updateContentCommand`, `postCreateCommand`, `postStartCommand`, `postAttachCommand`) and install dotfiles when a Dev Container opens. When off, Devin Desktop runs none of them and installs no dotfiles, as before lifecycle support.
Show a notification that offers to reopen the folder in a container when the folder has a Dev Container configuration file.
windsurf-remote-devin.contributes.config: Override the Devin API base URL used to look up cloud session machines (for example a local dev webserver). Must use https unless it points at localhost. Leave empty to derive it from the build.
windsurf-remote-openssh.contributes.comm: Connect to SSH Host in Current Window...
Connect to SSH Host in New Window
Connect to SSH Host in Current Window
Open on SSH Host in Current Window
Open on SSH Host in New Window
windsurf-remote-openssh.contributes.conf: The absolute file path to a custom SSH config file.
Specifies the timeout in seconds used for the SSH command that connects to the remote.
Experimental: Disable the server checksum verification. This is only recommended for development and testing.
Experimental: The name of the server binary, use this **only if** you are using a client without a corresponding server release.
Experimental: The URL from where the Devin server will be downloaded. The following variables can be substituted: ${os}, ${arch}, ${windsurfVersion}, ${vscodeVersion} ${commit}, ${quality}.
The HTTP proxy to pass to the Devin server. Kill running server (or wait for it to exit) for this change to take effect.
The HTTPS proxy to pass to the Devin server. Kill running server (or wait for it to exit) for this change to take effect.
The maximum number of times to attempt reconnection. Use 0 to disallow reconnection, and null to use the default of 8.
The absolute file path to the SSH executable. If empty, will use the ssh on the PATH.

The grace time in seconds to wait before terminating the remote server when the client disconnects. This allows the client to reconnect to the same server process after brief network disruptions. Leave empty to use the default. Currently supports only Linux remotes.

Map of SSH host names to absolute parent directories where the Devin remote server is installed. The `.devin-server` data directory is created beneath the configured path. Kill the running server (or wait for it to exit) for this change to take effect.

windsurf.contributes.configuration.prope: Map of ACP agent IDs to environment variables. Each key is an agent ID and the value is an object of environment variable key-value pairs passed to that agent's process.

Map of ACP agent IDs to default session config preferences. Each key is an agent ID and the value is an object mapping config option IDs to their preferred default values, applied automatically when a new session is created.
When enabled, ACP agent file edits open interactive diff zones with accept/reject controls. When disabled, edits are applied directly and the toolbar shows a simple dismiss button.
Map of ACP agent IDs to enabled/disabled state. Only agents listed here with a value of true will be instantiated.

When set to a valid ACP agent connector ID (e.g. 'claude-code', 'opencode', 'gemini', 'devin-cli'), newly created Cascade tabs will automatically select that agent if it is available. When left unset, new tabs default to Devin Local if it is available, otherwise Cascade.
Connect to saved hosts automatically on startup.
Connect to agents on remote machines over SSH.
Run format-on-save and code actions on save (e.g. gofmt) when Devin edits a file. When disabled, agent edits are saved without running save actions.
Let Devin see commands and output from your integrated terminal.
Let Devin see which files you edit and create in your workspace, and let a Devin Cloud session read unsaved edits when it reads a file on this machine.
Show native notifications when an agent session finishes or needs your input while in the background.
Allow Cascade, tab, and supercomplete to view and edit the files in .gitignore.

Controls whether Cascade automatically continues when it reaches the invocation limit. 0 or negative means auto-continue is on (Cascade continues indefinitely). A positive value (e.g. 40) means auto-continue is off (Cascade stops at that many invocations and prompts you to continue).
When enabled, Cascade will read skills from .claude directories (both local .claude/skills/ and global ~/.claude/skills/).

Controls the AI completion mode. Supercomplete provides the most capable completions including multi-line suggestions, autocomplete provides standard completions, and off disables AI completions entirely.
Stop Devin from opening files in the background when it creates or edits them.
Enable the Cursor-import commands in the palette
Opt-in backend environment. `beta` switches the api server and Devin web URLs to the beta environment (`server-beta.codeium.com`, `app.beta.devin.ai`). Requires a restart after changing.

Changes the base URL for marketplace search results. [Available Options](https://github.com/VSCodium/vscodium/blob/master/docs/index.md#extensions-marketplace). You must restart Devin to use the new marketplace after changing this value.

Changes the base URL on each extension page. [Available Options](https://github.com/VSCodium/vscodium/blob/master/docs/index.md#extensions-marketplace). You must restart Devin to use the new marketplace after changing this value.
**For multi-tenant deployments (Secure, EU, FedRAMP)**: Base URL of your Devin portal (e.g., `https://your-company.devin.com`). Requires a restart after toggling.
Default terminal profile for Linux when using Cascade
Default terminal profile for macOS when using Cascade
Default terminal profile for Windows when using Cascade
Timeout in milliseconds for the initial terminal shell support probe. Increase if the probe times out in slow environments.
